user.title: Prerequisites
user.description: MQTT and the stable Hikvision Doorbell app must be installed. Fix a missing prerequisite, then Submit to check again. This step never plays sound.

device.title: Indoor station connection
device.description: Use the device admin password, not your Hik-Connect account password. Only the existing local SDK app stores it; this integration entry does not.

confirm.title: Confirm bridge configuration
confirm.description: The Hikvision Doorbell app device settings will be updated and the app started/restarted if needed. Other panels in that app may briefly disconnect. No unlock, alarm, firmware or playback action is performed.

data.confirm_restart: I confirm configuration and app start/restart if needed

error.supervisor_required: Home Assistant OS/Supervisor is required. No Windows app is needed.
error.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration and broker first, then retry.
error.mqtt_disconnected: MQTT is configured but disconnected. Check the broker.
error.bridge_required: Install the stable Hikvision Doorbell app from https://github.com/pergolafabio/Hikvision-Addons first.
error.bridge_version: Hikvision Doorbell 3.0.34 or newer is required.
error.invalid_host: Enter a private IPv4 address, not a URL or public address.
error.invalid_port: SDK port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_credentials: Enter the device admin username/password, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes each, without control characters.
error.ambiguous_bridge_device: The bridge has duplicate devices or colliding names. Resolve these before setup.
error.bridge_device_missing: The configured bridge device no longer exists. Restore it before reconfiguring.
error.invalid_bridge_name: The bridge device name must use basic letters, digits, spaces, underscores or hyphens.
error.bridge_config_failed: Bridge configuration/start failed. Previous options were restored. Check the app and retry.
error.bridge_rollback_failed: Bridge setup AND restoration failed. Restore the app configuration from your native HA backup.
error.bridge_entities_missing: Required MQTT broadcast entities are missing, disabled or ambiguous. Check device login and MQTT discovery.
error.bridge_stopped: The Hikvision Doorbell app is stopped. Start it explicitly.
error.bridge_unavailable: The required broadcast controls are unavailable. No sound was requested.
error.integration_not_ready: The integration is not loaded. Fix its setup error before changing audio.
error.invalid_gain: Gain must be a finite number between -30 and +30 dB.
error.invalid_repeats: Repetitions must be a whole number between 1 and 10.
error.invalid_file_size: WAV file must be non-empty and no larger than 1 MiB.
error.invalid_wav: The uploaded file is not a valid supported WAV.
error.unsupported_wav: Use uncompressed 8000 Hz, mono, signed 16-bit PCM WAV. Convert other formats before upload.
error.invalid_duration: Source audio must be longer than zero and at most 30 seconds.
error.consent_required: Confirm the bridge configuration/restart to continue.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the bridge configuration/restart to continue.
error.truncated_wav: The WAV is incomplete. Upload the original complete file.
error.total_duration_exceeded: Audio duration multiplied by repetitions must not exceed 60 seconds.
error.busy: A chime operation is already active. Nothing was queued.
error.unsafe_storage: Audio storage contains an unsafe link or inconsistent file. Check the local storage.
error.source_limit: The per-device limit of 16 distinct audio uploads has been reached. Existing audio is preserved.
error.call_active: The bridge does not report idle. Chime was blocked to avoid interrupting a call.
error.call_state_missing: No unambiguous call-state sensor is available. Chime was blocked.
error.playback_request_failed: The sound request failed. Audible playback was not confirmed.
error.stop_request_failed: The stop request failed. Check the SDK app; the bounded audio file should finish itself.
error.storage_unavailable: Private audio storage is not accessible.

init.title: Audio and repetition settings
init.description: File is optional. WAV: 8000 Hz, mono, 16-bit PCM; max 1 MiB/30 seconds. Combined repetitions max 60 seconds. Positive gain may distort and cannot raise the hardware volume limit. Saving does not play sound.
